title: HxAgent: Iterative Agent Planning for End-to-End Web Application Testing
abstract: arXiv:2608.15491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In automated web testing, generating test cases and performing testing using functionality descriptions in natural-language is crucial for improving efficacy. These tasks require such a testing agent to carry out tasks on the target application and generating tests autonomously. We introduce HxAgent, an iterative LLM-based planning agent with a proactive correction strategy. After each step, HxAgent reassesses the web state to determine the next action using (1) current observations, (2) short-term memory of past actions, and (3) long-term experience extracted from past (in)correct sequences of actions. HxAgent achieves 97.4% Exact-Match accuracy on MiniWoB++, comparable to the best baselines without human demonstrations and surpassing the recent WALT by 10.5%. On a dataset of 350 web tasks, it attains 83.8% Exact-Match and 91.8% Prefix-Match, exceeding WALT by 13.4%. On OnlineMind2Web, it further improves over WALT by 4.6%.

translated_title: HxAgent：面向端到端Web应用测试的迭代代理规划
translated_abstract: 在自动化Web测试中，使用自然语言功能描述生成测试用例并执行测试对于提高效率至关重要。这些任务要求测试代理在目标应用上执行任务并自主生成测试。我们引入了HxAgent，一种基于迭代LLM的规划代理，具有主动纠正策略。在每一步之后，HxAgent重新评估Web状态，以使用（1）当前观察，（2）过去动作的短期记忆，以及（3）从过去（不）正确动作序列中提取的长期经验来确定下一步动作。HxAgent在MiniWoW++上实现了97.4%的精确匹配准确率，与无需人类演示的最佳基线相当，并超过最近的WALT 10.5%。在一个包含350个Web任务的数据集上，它达到了83.8%的精确匹配和91.8%的前缀匹配，超过WALT 13.4%。在OnlineMind2Web上，它进一步比WALT提高了4.6%。
tldr: HxAgent通过迭代规划和主动纠正策略，利用短期记忆和长期经验，在Web应用测试中显著提升了任务完成准确率，超越了现有方法。
en_tdlr: HxAgent improves end-to-end web application testing through iterative planning and proactive correction, leveraging short-term memory and long-term experience to achieve superior accuracy over existing baselines.
